terms.gloss: easy to talk to, courteous, friendly
evidence: Cic. Off. 1.113: omnibus adfābilem esse (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: From affārī, speak to: someone who can easily be spoken to.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 269.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
